source: Fresh generated openDEV synthetic factual worlds; no inherited dataset or protected/sealed payload is read.

question_templates.two_hop: Which locker stores the parcel carried by courier Cdddd?

fact_templates: Parcel Pdddd is stored in locker Ldddd.
entity_construction: Per-world seeded random distinct four-digit courier/parcel/locker identifiers, all using the same lexical templates. Support identifiers use the same identifier format as irrelevant facts.
support_placement: Required support sentence(s) are an adjacent block at start, midpoint of 64 irrelevant facts, or end. All three versions reuse the identical question, factual sentences and support IDs.
freeze_before_scores: Serialize all 192 public contexts and evaluator-only support records in separate JSONL files; write FROZEN_INPUTS.json with byte sizes and SHA-256, config/protocol/implementation/native-tokenizer bindings; re-read and verify frozen bytes before any retrieval scores. Freeze is construction, not a measured scientific result.
retriever_boundary: Each algorithm receives only question + public sentence_id/text records. No world type, position, gold answer, support IDs, expected evidence or evaluator object is passed. The public-schema guard rejects additional fields.

methods.lead_prefix: Rank original factual sentences in source order.
methods.seeded_random: Seeded random permutation of sentence identities sorted by public sentence_id, seed derived from frozen base seed and canonical question + public sentence inventory sorted by sentence_id. The same world has the same identity ranking across its three placements, preventing position from changing the random draw.
methods.bm25_one_hop: Standard nonnegative BM25 IDF log(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)), k1=1.2,b=0.75, binary query terms, ASCII alphanumeric casefold terms, no stopword removal; source order breaks ties.
methods.bm25_two_pass: Run one-hop BM25, expand the question using the text of its single top public sentence, run BM25 again, and retain that first-pass seed sentence first before expanded-query ranks. No evaluator evidence is used.

packing: For every method/budget, take the longest whole-sentence ranking prefix that fits when restored to source order; stop at the first additional sentence that exceeds the budget. Final selected facts are restored to original source order. Lead-prefix therefore remains a contiguous source prefix. Partial sentences are forbidden.
padding: After whole-sentence selection, repeatedly test the fixed suffix candidates [newline, space+filler, space+x, space+0, space] in order; append the first that increases raw tokenizer length by exactly one. Fail if none works. This inserts evaluator-independent irrelevant lexical/whitespace filler, never support or answers. Preserve every suffix, final raw text and exact net padding-token count. All methods consume exactly the same 128/256/512 actual context tokens; their sentence/chunk/sample counts may differ.
native_budget_scope: 128/256/512 refer only to raw selected factual context plus padding under the local Rineya tokenizer with add_special_tokens=False. Query and chat formatting overhead are excluded; this does not establish a native total envelope or usable model context budget.
metrics: full evidence recall: all one/two required support IDs selected
any evidence recall: at least one required support ID selected
support precision among selected original factual sentences
selected-context tokens and net padding tokens
timing_scope: One ranking measurement per case/method is reused for three budgets; packing measured separately per budget. Raw tokenizer time is included in packing, not ranking. Wall/RSS evidence covers all generation, tokenization, freezing, ranking, packing and reporting work.
aggregation: Report case means, separate single/two-hop and early/middle/late strata, and each world's mean over its three paired positions. World-cluster descriptive means/min/max expose the reuse of one world across positions; no independence of 192 worlds, confidence intervals, significance, population claims or result-based algorithm tuning.
interpretation: Synthetic construction/evidence-retention diagnosis only. No answer correctness, reasoning intelligence improvement, deployed selector, native model usage or Lost in the Middle replication is claimed.
runtime: One CPU worker, Python stdlib + tokenizers 0.22.2 raw encode only; TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false within this process. No Transformers, Torch, NumPy, model/weight/adapter loading or GPU computation.
forbidden: using equal sentence count as evidence of equal token cost
claiming answer accuracy or model gains
